title: Epimorphisms of abelian etale sheaves are exactly the locally surjective maps
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme, $X_{\Et}$ its small etale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-site], and $\varphi:\mathcal G\to\mathcal H$ a morphism in the abelian category $\Ab(X_{\Et})$ of abelian sheaves [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves]. Then $\varphi$ is an epimorphism of $\Ab(X_{\Et})$ if and only if it is locally surjective: for every object $U$ of $X_{\Et}$ and every $h\in\mathcal H(U)$ there are a covering $\{V_j\to U\}_{j\in J}$ of $U$ in $X_{\Et}$ and sections $g_j\in\mathcal G(V_j)$ with $\varphi_{V_j}(g_j)=h|_{V_j}$ for all $j\in J$.
